about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Prawn Egg Foo Yung Omelettes with Gravy
recipes.summary: Fluffy prawn and bean sprout omelettes with a glossy soy gravy.
steps: Beat the eggs with the prawns, sprouts, spring onion and sesame oil.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook ladles of the mixture for 2 minutes each side until golden and fully set.
Simmer the stock, soy sauce and cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water for 2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Serve the omelettes with the gravy poured over.
notes: Food safety: prawns must be pink and opaque and the egg fully set.
Lunch. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Crisp Pork in Pineapple Sweet Sour Glaze
recipes.summary: Crunchy battered pork pieces tossed in a tangy pineapple and capsicum sauce.
steps: Whisk the cornflour, plain flour and water into a thick batter and coat the pork.
Shallow-fry the pork in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until golden, crisp and cooked through.
Simmer the tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce for 3 minutes until syrupy, then add the capsicum and pineapple.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, toss the pork through the sauce and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C throughout with no pink.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Black Pepper Beef with Capsicum
recipes.summary: Tender beef strips stir-fried with cracked pepper and capsicum in a rich soy sauce.
steps: Toss the beef with the cornflour and the soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef in the oil in a very hot wok for 2 minutes until browned, then lift out.
Stir-fry the onion, capsicum and garlic for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the beef with the pepper and oyster sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: thin beef strips are cooked when no pink remains and they reach 71°C.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Chive and Tofu Dumplings
recipes.summary: Crisp-based dumplings filled with garlic chives, tofu and mushroom.
steps: Mix the tofu, chives, mushroom, 1 tbsp soy sauce and sesame oil.
Fill and seal each wrapper with a spoonful of the mixture.
Fry the dumplings flat-side down in the oil for 3 minutes until golden, add the water, cover and steam for 6 minutes until the wrappers are translucent.
Mix the vinegar with the remaining soy sauce and serve for dipping.
notes: Lunch. Vegan.

recipes.title: Savoury Rice Porridge with Pickled Mustard Greens
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge topped with pickled greens, spring onion and a soft egg.
steps: Simmer the rice with the water for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the grains break down and the porridge is thick.
Soft-boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Ladle the porridge into bowls and top with the egg, greens, spring onion and fried shallots.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: soft-boiled eggs are not recommended for pregnant or vulnerable people; boil for 10 minutes instead. Breakfast. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Hong Kong-Style Peanut French Toast
recipes.summary: Thick toast sandwiches with peanut butter, dipped in egg and pan-fried golden.
steps: Spread two slices with peanut butter and top with the other two.
Beat the eggs and milk, and dip the sandwiches until soaked through.
Melt the butter and fry the sandwiches for 3 minutes each side until deep golden and the egg is set.
Serve drizzled with golden syrup.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg coating until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Crumbed Chicken Katsu Sandwiches
recipes.summary: Crisp chicken cutlets with shredded cabbage and tangy sauce in soft white bread.
steps: Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally and flatten to an even thickness.
Coat in flour, then egg, then panko.
Shallow-fry for 4 minutes each side until golden and the chicken is cooked through.
Mix the tomato sauce and Worcestershire, spread on the bread with the mayonnaise, and fill with the chicken and cabbage.
notes: Food safety: the chicken must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink.
Lunch.

recipes.title: Ginger Soy Pork Slices on Rice
recipes.summary: Thin pork slices pan-fried in a ginger soy glaze, served with rice and cabbage.
steps: Mix the ginger, soy sauce, mirin and sake and marinate the pork.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Fry the pork in the oil in a hot pan for 5 minutes until cooked through and glazed, adding the leftover marinade for the last minute.
Serve over the rice with cabbage.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C with no pink. Plus 15 minutes marinating. Dairy-free.
Dinner.

recipes.title: Cabbage Yakisoba with Egg
recipes.summary: Pan-fried noodles with cabbage and carrot in a sweet-savoury sauce, topped with a fried egg.
steps: Boil the noodles for 2 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Stir-fry the onion, carrot and cabbage in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the noodles, okonomiyaki sauce and soy sauce and toss for 3 minutes until glossy.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.
Serve the noodles topped with an egg and furikake.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set and yolks as firm as you prefer. Lunch.

recipes.title: Inari Rice Pockets
recipes.summary: Sweet tofu pockets stuffed with seasoned sushi rice and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved and fold through the rice with the sesame seed and ginger.
Open each tofu puff and pack it with rice until plump.
Serve at room temperature.
notes: Snack. Vegan.

recipes.title: Miso Mushroom Egg Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Gentle miso rice porridge with mushrooms, ginger and a stirred-in egg.
steps: Simmer the dashi with the mushrooms and ginger for 8 minutes until the mushrooms are tender.
Add the rinsed rice and simmer for 20 minutes until the grains have swollen and the porridge is thick.
Whisk the miso into a ladle of the broth and stir it back in off the heat.
Pour in the beaten egg and stir for 1 minute until set, then top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Cool and refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour. Breakfast.

recipes.title: Seaweed Kimchi Rice Pan with Fried Eggs
recipes.summary: Sizzling kimchi rice topped with a crisp-edged fried egg and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method, cool and refrigerate within 1 hour, ready for this dish.
Fry the kimchi in 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes until softened, then add the rice and gochujang and toss for 4 minutes until hot and crisp in places.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set and the edges crisp.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the eggs, sesame oil, spring onion and nori.
notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice and refrigerate it within 1 hour; reheat until steaming hot. Lunch.

recipes.title: Gochujang Pork Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Sticky, spicy pork mince spooned into crisp lettuce leaves with pickled carrot.
steps: Toss the carrot with the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Fry the pork in the oil over high heat for 8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the gochujang, soy sauce and honey for 2 minutes until sticky.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Serve the pork in lettuce leaves with pickled carrot and rice.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Gamja Jeon Crisp Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Shredded potato pancakes fried until lacy and crisp, with a soy dipping sauce.
steps: Squeeze the liquid from the potato and onion and mix with the chilli, potato starch and salt.
Heat the oil in a pan and press in half the mixture into a thin round.
Fry for 5 minutes each side until deep golden and crisp, and repeat.
Mix the soy sauce and vinegar for dipping.
notes: Snack. Vegan.

recipes.title: Gilgeori Cabbage Egg Toast Sandwiches
recipes.summary: Egg and cabbage omelette sandwiched in buttery toast with a sugar and ketchup finish.
steps: Beat the eggs with the cabbage, carrot and spring onion.
Cook half the mixture in a pan for 3 minutes each side until fully set. Repeat, then fold each omelette to fit the bread.
Toast the bread in the butter until golden.
Sprinkle the omelettes with sugar, spread with tomato sauce and sandwich in the toast, pressing until warm.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelettes until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Gochujang Tofu and Zucchini Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Silky pan-seared tofu and zucchini glazed in a sweet gochujang sauce, served on rice.
steps: Pan-fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden on each side, then lift out.
Cook the zucchini and garlic in the same pan for 4 minutes until just tender.
Stir the gochujang, soy sauce, maple syrup and 2 tbsp water together, pour in and simmer for 2 minutes until glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the tofu, zucchini and sesame seed.
notes: Dinner. Vegan.

recipes.title: Garlic Pepper Chicken Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Garlicky peppered chicken strips with fried egg over fragrant rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Stir-fry the chicken with the garlic and pepper in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the oyster sauce and soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set, and serve everything over the rice with cucumber.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; the egg whites must be set.
Lunch. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Red Curry Prawns with Pineapple
recipes.summary: Plump prawns in a sweet-sour coconut red curry with pineapple and basil.
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the pineapple and prawns and cook for 3 minutes until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Stir the basil through the curry and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink and opaque.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Thai Sweet Corn Fritters with Cucumber Dip
recipes.summary: Crisp golden corn fritters with chilli and coriander, served with a sweet-sour dip.
steps: Mix the corn, rice flour, egg, curry paste and coriander into a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Fry spoonfuls for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp and cooked through, then drain.
Stir the sweet chilli sauce with the cucumber and vinegar and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: fry until the centres are set. Snack. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Steamed Fish Curry Custard Cups
recipes.summary: Silky steamed coconut curry custard with fish, set in little cups.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce and sugar until smooth.
Fold in the fish, lime leaf and spinach and spoon into 4 heatproof cups.
Steam over simmering water for 22 minutes until the custard is set and the fish flakes easily.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the custards.
notes: Food safety: the fish must be opaque and flake and the custard fully set.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Banh Mi Rolls
recipes.summary: Lemongrass pork patties in crusty rolls with pickled carrot, cucumber and chilli.
steps: Toss the carrot with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and rest.
Mix the pork, lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and sugar and shape into 8 small patties.
Grill or pan-fry for 6 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Spread the rolls with mayonnaise and fill with patties, pickled carrot, cucumber, chilli and coriander.
notes: Food safety: pork patties must reach 75°C throughout with no pink.
Lunch.

recipes.title: Caramel Clay-Pot Style Fish
recipes.summary: Fish fillets simmered in a dark caramel, fish sauce and pepper glaze, served with rice.
steps: Cook the sugar and 2 tbsp water in a wide pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until deep amber.
Add the shallot, garlic, fish sauce and 1/4 cup water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Lay in the fish and spoon over the sauce, cooking for 8 minutes until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve topped with pepper, chilli and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: the fish is cooked when the flesh turns opaque and flakes with a fork.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sticky Rice with Peanuts and Coconut
recipes.summary: Sweet-salty sticky rice with toasted peanuts, sesame and coconut for a hearty breakfast.
steps: Soak the rice for 2 hours, drain, and cook with the water, coconut milk and salt, covered, for 20 minutes until tender and sticky.
Toast the peanuts, sesame and coconut in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden, then crush with the sugar.
Spoon the rice into bowls and top with the peanut mix.
notes: Plus 2 hours soaking. Breakfast. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ginger Tofu and Mushroom Clay Pot Rice
recipes.summary: Sticky ginger soy tofu and mushrooms steamed over crisp-bottomed rice in one pot.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with the water in a heavy pot, covered, for 12 minutes until most of the water is absorbed.
Fry the tofu, mushrooms and ginger in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, then add the soy sauce and sugar for 1 minute.
Spread the tofu mixture over the rice, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and a crust forms underneath.
Top with spring onion and serve from the pot.
notes: Dinner. Vegan.
